headline: Apple Beats Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates on Strong iPhone Sales
summary: Apple reported quarterly profit and revenue that beat Wall Street expectations, driven by strong iPhone sales.
why: Apple is one of the world's largest technology companies and a major component of major stock indices, making its financial results a key bellwether for the tech sector and broader consumer demand.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected quarterly profit and revenue reports typically drive positive equity price reactions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected quarterly results driven by strong iPhone sales exceeded analyst estimates, leading to positive market sentiment.
